items.statement: Consolidated revenue rose 21% year-on-year to ₹48,716 crore due to broad-based growth across business segments.
items.quote: Consolidated revenue at ₹48,716 Cr. up 21% YoY driven by strong all-round performance across its diversified businesses portfolio

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA achieved a record ₹8,077 crore, increasing 26% year-on-year through top-line growth and cost management.
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA stood highest-ever at ₹8,077 Cr., up 26% YoY, driven by revenue-led growth and cost efficiencies across businesses

items.statement: Caustic soda sales volumes dropped 6% year-on-year because of reduced output during a captive power plant maintenance shutdown.
items.quote: Caustic Soda sales volume de-grew 6% YoY due to lower production on account of captive power plant maintenance shutdown

items.statement: Cellulosic Fashion Yarn sales volume declined 7% year-on-year due to labour shortages and soft demand across the textile chain.
items.quote: CFY sales volumes de-grew by 7% YoY due to labour shortage and subdued demand in the textile value chain

items.statement: CSF total sales volume decreased by 4% year-on-year because of scheduled maintenance shutdowns and soft downstream demand.
items.quote: CSF total sales volumes stood at 202 KT, down by 4% YoY, due to lower production on account of planned maintenance and subdued downstream demand

items.statement: Decorative paints revenue grew significantly, supported by an 8.8% price increase implemented during the quarter.
items.quote: Revenue stood at ₹1,661 Cr., growth of 64% YoY, 17% QoQ with overall impact of price hike in Q1FY27 at 8.8%

items.statement: Consolidated cement EBITDA expanded by 12% year-on-year supported by volume growth and decreased power and logistics expenses.
items.quote: Consolidated EBITDA grew by 12% YoY to ₹5,146 Cr., led by volume growth and lower logistics & power costs

items.statement: Cellulosic Fashion Yarn profitability saw slight gains supported by firm selling prices despite elevated input costs.
items.quote: CFY revenue and EBITDA improved marginally on back of firm pricing amid higher input costs

items.statement: B2B E-commerce gross margins showed continuous improvement, keeping the segment on course for EBITDA break-even by the end of FY27.
items.quote: Gross margins continue to improve; the business remains on track to achieve EBITDA break-even by exit of FY27

items.statement: The B2B E-commerce segment expects to reach EBITDA break-even by the close of FY27 via scale and operating efficiencies.
items.quote: The business remains on track to achieve break-even by exit of FY27, driven by scale, operating leverage and disciplined execution

items.statement: The chemicals business targets raising the share of renewable power capacity to 45% by the end of FY27.
items.quote: Focus on cost competitiveness with share of renewable power capacity expected to reach 45% by exit of FY27.

items.statement: The 50K TPA CPVC project at Vilayat was inaugurated in June 2026 and achieved commissioning in August 2026.
items.quote: CPVC Project of 50K TPA at Vilayat inaugurated in Jun’26 and commissioned in Aug’26.

items.statement: Grey cement total capacity reached 205.5 MTPA across domestic and international operations following an 8.7 MTPA expansion.
items.quote: Grey cement capacity expanded by 8.7 MTPA, taking total grey cement capacity (India and Overseas) to 205.5 MTPA

items.statement: The company's net debt to trailing twelve months EBITDA stood at 1.45x as of June 30, 2026.
items.quote: Net Debt* to TTM EBITDA stood at 1.45x as on 30th June 2026 against 1.62x as on 30th June 2025

items.statement: Birla Opus launched 10 new products and 95 SKUs, expanding its portfolio to 228 products.
items.quote: 10 new products and 95 SKUs launched, product range expanded to 228 products and 1,945+ SKUs

items.statement: The Indian cellulosic fibre market is expanding at more than double the global CSF compound annual growth rate.
items.quote: India Cellulosic Fibre growing fastest with CAGR >2x of the global CSF

items.statement: positive
items.quote: The business remains on track to achieve break-even by exit of FY27, driven by scale, operating leverage and disciplined execution

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA rose by 107% year-on-year to reach INR 1,094 crores during the first quarter.
items.quote: EBITDA more than doubled with a 107% growth to INR1,094 crores. This clearly shows that the standalone portfolio is not only growing faster but also scaling with speed and improving profitability.

items.statement: Birla Opus achieved first-quarter revenue of INR 1,661 crores, representing 64% year-on-year growth and sequential market share gains.
items.quote: This quarter, Birla Opus delivered revenue of INR1,661 crores, up by 64% year-on-year and 17% sequentially. We've strengthened our number three position with market share gain of further 30 basis points sequentially

items.statement: Cellulosic staple fiber sales volumes declined 4% year-on-year because of scheduled maintenance and lower downstream demand.
items.quote: Talking about financial performance, CSF sales volumes were down 4% year-on-year. Two reasons for volume degrowth: planned maintenance that reduced production, and subdued downstream demand.

items.statement: Standalone net debt increased to INR 9,899 crores due to the timing gap between capital investments and incoming dividends.
items.quote: On standalone level, net debt increased to INR9,899 crores. This is largely due to timing difference between recent investment made in June 26 in Aditya Birla Capital and dividend to be received from UltraTech in August 26.

items.statement: Management guides for over 50% year-on-year revenue growth in Birla Opus for the full financial year.
items.quote: Thank you Jay. Yes, on a Y-on-Y basis we are guiding over 50% revenue, which is the second part of your question.

items.statement: Standalone capital expenditure for FY27 is projected at INR 3,157 crores, with roughly 45% targeted at growth projects.
items.quote: Coming to capital expenditure, the standalone plan for FY27 is expected at INR3,157 crores. Nearly 45% of this capex is dedicated to growth capex.

items.statement: Grasim will cap its equity investment in the renewables venture at less than INR 1,000 crores during the current financial year.
items.quote: Renewable we will be investing not more than INR1,000 crores in the current financial year.

items.statement: Management expects Birla Pivot to reach EBITDA break-even by the exit of FY27.
items.quote: Birla Pivot remains on track to achieve EBITDA break-even by exit of FY27.

items.statement: Chlorine integration is targeted to reach 68% by the end of the current fiscal year following new plant commissions.
items.quote: As CPVC got recently commissioned and ECH commissioning happening in quarter two of FY27, chlorine integration is expected to reach 68% by exit of the current financial year.

items.statement: Domestic downstream demand for cellulosic fiber weakened slightly, but export markets absorbed the additional volume.
items.quote: Two, there is also a slight drop in the downstream demand in India, but thankfully the demand in outside India was good, so we were able to export, increase exports

items.statement: A structural shortfall in cotton supply is creating sustained demand for cellulosic fibers.
items.quote: Cotton is running into hard limits. Land is finite, water is scarce, and yields have plateaued. That constraint has opened up what we call the cellulosic gap.

items.statement: ECU realizations increased 6% year-on-year to INR 37,955 per ton, mirroring regional caustic soda price rises.
items.quote: Caustic soda prices in Southeast Asia exited the quarter at USD483 per ton, up from USD468 we saw year ago. Our ECU realization followed the same path, up 6% year-on-year to INR37,955 per ton.

items.statement: Birla Opus implemented phased price increases totaling 8.8% in the first quarter to address raw material inflation.
items.quote: We chose to manage it through phased price increases rather than one blunt correction, and the cumulative impact in quarter one FY27 was 8.8% and some of the price increase impact has flown to quarter two of FY27.

items.statement: Birla Opus encountered a 20% to 25% increase in cost of goods sold driven by raw material inflation.
items.quote: The raw material cost has increased on a COGS basis anywhere between 20% to 25% and as a percentage of revenue between 10% to 14% depending on the month.

items.statement: The cellulosic fiber business experienced rising input costs for sulfur and caustic soda.
items.quote: One, in terms of costs, we have seen a surge in the some of input prices, say of sulfur and partially caustic.

items.statement: Petrochemical feedstock costs fluctuated rapidly alongside freight and shipping container shortages.
items.quote: You also know that feedstock prices for petrochemicals, which are raw materials which are used by our chlorine customers, they are literally changing overnight, there are shipping shortages, there are container shortages.

items.statement: Birla Opus narrowed its quarterly losses thanks to normalized advertising expenses and lower-cost inventory.
items.quote: On profitability, losses narrowed during the quarter, partly aided by lower cost carrying inventory and lower advertising spends compared to quarter four FY26 when we have invested heavily behind high-impact campaigns around the T20 World Cup and IPL.

items.statement: Chemical business margins face upcoming pressure in the second quarter as higher-cost raw material inventory is consumed.
items.quote: Having said that, second quarter we will of course be selling material from stocks which we purchased in the first quarter which were more expensive, so there will be pressure on our margins, but it's a volatile situation.

items.statement: First-quarter standalone capital expenditure reached INR 375 crores, representing approximately 12% of the annual budget.
items.quote: The total spent in quarter one stood at INR375 crores which is nearly 12% of the budget.

items.statement: Civil work and detailed engineering are underway for the INR 1,350 crore Lyocell Phase 1 project.
items.quote: The earlier announced INR1,350 crores Phase 1 project of 55,000 ton per annum is completing its detailed engineering and civil work is progressing as per plans.

items.statement: The company's INR 3,094 crore Lyocell Phase 2 expansion is progressing through environmental approvals.
items.quote: The recently approved INR3,094 crores Phase 2 project of 110,000 TPA is moving through environmental clearance.

items.statement: The company expanded its total gray cement capacity to 205.5 million tons after commissioning 8.7 million tons during the quarter.
items.quote: We added 8.7 million tons of gray cement capacity in the quarter, taking total gray cement capacity across India and overseas to 205.5 million tons.

items.statement: Birla Opus reached peak production across all six manufacturing plants within its 1,332 million liters per annum capacity.
items.quote: Our integrated manufacturing footprint of 1,332 million liters per annum capacity continues to provide significant competitive advantage. This quarter marked our highest ever production with capacity utilization continuing to improve steadily across all six plants.

items.statement: Birla Opus has built an institutional pipeline containing 47,000 project sites across various stages.
items.quote: Birla Opus products have secured 83 plus specification approvals from various government and other departments across cities with a similar number under different stages of approval. With a robust pipeline of 47,000 sites at various stages of work

items.statement: Consolidated net debt to trailing twelve months EBITDA declined to 1.45 times at the end of the quarter.
items.quote: On balance sheet, as profitability improved, consolidated net debt to TTM EBITDA declined to 1.45 times as on 30th June 2026 compared to 1.62 times in the same period last year.

items.statement: Grasim introduced a parent brand royalty payment of 0.25% of standalone revenue effective from June.
items.quote: Yes, it is applicable for Grasim also. So it will be 0.25% of standalone revenue starting from June.

items.statement: Birla Opus introduced 10 new products to enhance offerings across institutional and dealer networks.
items.quote: During quarter one FY27, Birla Opus launched 10 new products to strengthen its exclusive range for institutional franchise channels and regular products for dealer channel.

items.statement: The chemicals business inaugurated and began commercial dispatches from its new CPVC facility.
items.quote: And you have seen that we have already inaugurated our CPVC plant, in fact we made our first commercial shipments, we made a stock exchange declaration also yesterday. We are in the process of commissioning our ECH plant

items.statement: Paint manufacturers instituted double-digit price hikes in Q1, prompting dealer channels to accumulate inventory.
items.quote: This quarter, most paint companies have increased their prices by double-digit. So it gave opportunity to the channel partners to stock up. The revenues this quarter reported high revenues by the industry as it has a component of consumer sales

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions in Europe and the Middle East continue to disrupt global supply chains and trade stability.
items.quote: The ongoing conflicts in parts of Europe and the Middle East, coupled with the evolving trade policies and supply chains realignments, have increased uncertainty across global markets. These developments have at times disrupted shipping routes, elongated transit times

items.statement: Volatile energy prices and freight rates present ongoing challenges for commodity availability and procurement.
items.quote: These developments have at times disrupted shipping routes, elongated transit times, and created intermittent challenges around the availability and pricing of key commodities and raw materials. Freight costs and energy prices have also witnessed bouts of volatility

items.statement: positive
items.quote: We are not chasing break-even by shrinking; we are reaching it by scaling into a cost base we have already built. Birla Pivot remains on track to achieve EBITDA break-even by exit of FY27.
